svg.title: Prototype vs production AI
svg.desc: A prototype is a four-step flow from question to chat response. In production the same chat window sits on top of identity, retrieval quality, grounding, resilience, cost control, evaluation, observability and ownership.

text.font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Manrope, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
